comments.author: @rainsdude
comments.text: As a recent visitor to Slovenia I can honestly agree it is a beautiful country. We used Ljubljana as a base and visited several of the more notable attractions. As for the natural beauty of the land, the Soca Valley and Kranjska Gora were absolutely stunning. Yes the grads and slaps were very nice to visit also. Though I must say the days and nights of strolling along the river in Ljubljana will forever resonate in my heart. The warmth and friendliness of the Slovenian people was exceptional. ❤
